title: feat(metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, objectql)!: /meta reads an item by its namespace or _env, and ?package= is the exact qualifier
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ff4UJdxHJzwSQG7VEko8ou)_

Part of #31691

ADR-0150 child G1, part (a) of three (seat ruling 2026-11-09T12:42Z: (a) `/meta`, (b) `/actions`, (c) automation, hooks and connectors; Q1, Q2 and Q3 all A). G2 (#31692, PR #31955) has merged; part (b) reuses its namespace→package mapping. Claim by `domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmQv69sQL5nfT8xuPWs.

Clause-②: no (narrowing). Measured by the base arms below and by ablation. `?package=X` no longer serves another package's item, the runtime's bare read of a two-holder name no longer falls through to the by-name service read, the activation door refuses where it answered 503 or picked the first rule, and the running install door refuses six namespaces it accepted (a package the boot registers under one still boots, warned once). The only new surface is the qualified read path, which answered 404 on base.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed. The running install door now refuses a namespace value (`actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth`, `trigger`) that an author could write before. Nothing else an author writes changes. (Step 0 estimated `none` for the read path. The install refusal is a refused value, so the line is `narrowed` and the changeset is `minor`.)

> [!WARNING]
> **BREAKING**, four narrowings. First-party census: 0 in the four example apps and every first-party manifest (no namespace is one of the six literals; no first-party read sends `?package=` for a name the package does not hold). Studio's pair reads (`?package=<app>.custom`) keep their answer and are pinned.
> 1. `?package=X` on `GET /meta/:type/:name`, for E8's nine types, answers X's item or `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder. Base served the first-registered package's item.
> 2. The runtime dispatcher's bare read of a two-holder name answers the protocol's `409`. Base fell through to the by-name metadata service read and served its first match. REST already answered 409.
> 3. `POST /security/_activation/:type/:name` for a sharing rule, queue or assignment rule two packages declare answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with every candidate in `details.candidates`, and writes nothing. Base answered 503 for sharing rule and queue, and switched off the first-listed assignment rule (200).
> 4. A package whose namespace is one of the six address literals is refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` at the running install door (a marketplace or API install after the boot), as is an upgrade that moves a namespace onto one. A package the boot registers under one, already installed or shipped in code, boots with one warning and is read by `?package=<id>`; so does a reload or upgrade that keeps its namespace.

<!-- adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) — carried in the changeset -->

This is a narrowing, so the review of record runs at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`/meta` 按名读取支持 D5 的限定地址：`GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name`（已安装命名空间）和 `GET /meta/:type/_env/:name`（环境自己的项），两个传输面（REST 和运行时分发器）都有。`?package=X` 变成精确限定：X 不持有该名就 409 列出所有持有者。安装门拒绝拼成路由字面量的命名空间。激活门遇到两个包同名的声明改答 409 并列出全部候选。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D5 要求有歧义的按名地址点名而不是猜。之前 `?package=X` 会悄悄返回别的包的项，运行时还会绕过协议的拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄，第一方 0 处受影响。控制台对两持有者名的裸读会收到 409 并当作不存在（ui 车道另开读取卡）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（精确限定和地址解析的唯一实现），`domains/meta.ts` 顶部的改写段，`meta-qualified-item-route.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`，预期 13 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位复审后落地。D5 的子资源字面量优先规则（Q1）留给 ADR 修订卡，见文末。

## What changes

- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`** (new). One implementation for both transports:
  - `admitExactQualifier`: for E8's nine types (`registry.readsByPackage`), a read naming package X is admitted when X holds the name, or X is a customization pair of a holder (`pairsOf`), or a stored row bound to X carries it (active or draft). Otherwise it throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, new reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, naming every holder and the environment's own item. With no holder anywhere, the read answers its own miss.
  - `exactQualifierItem`: when the layer below (the registry's prefer-local read) answered another installed package's item, it serves the admitted holder's item instead. Two pair bases that both hold the name are refused `ambiguous-in-closure`.
  - `resolveMetaItemAddress`: reads the middle segment in D5's order (`_env`, then an installed namespace via `getNamespaceOwners`, else nothing). A namespace two packages co-own names the owner that holds the name. When more than one of its owners holds the name (a shareable namespace, `base`, `system` or `sys`, is exempt from the one-holder install rule, D2), it throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, new reason `ambiguous-in-namespace`, naming each holder: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` on both transports, never a pick (contract review must-fix, fixed in 40a88d882).
  - `admitEnvironmentQualifier`: `_env` answers the environment's own item, or refuses naming the package holders.
  - `META_ITEM_SUBRESOURCE_SEGMENTS`: the literals served after `:name` on either transport (Q1). `resolveMetaItemAddress` answers no address when the last segment is one of them, so both transports read the rule from one place.
- **`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`**, **`protocol.ts`**: the item read calls the two exact-qualifier steps; the protocol exposes `resolveMetaItemAddress` and `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (on the canonical-fold roster).
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`** (`installPackage`): the address-literal namespace refusal (`validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral`, `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`) answers at the running install door only, i.e. a marketplace or API install after the boot, and an upgrade that moves an installed package's namespace onto a literal. A package the boot registers under such a namespace (already installed, or shipped in code: every registration before the cold boot seals the holders), or a reload or upgrade of it that keeps its namespace, boots as before with one warning naming the package and its `?package=<id>` read (epic red-line R1, fixed in 51c58a525 and dfb9174e6). No upgrade-report findings seam exists yet; the seat's follow-up card names these there and adds a build-time refusal.
- **`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`**: reasons `not-held-by-qualifier` and `ambiguous-in-namespace` and their sentences.
- **`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts`** (new): `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:ns/:name`, registered after every other `/meta` route so each literal three-segment sibling wins. It answers through the item read's own handler (`registerMetaItemReadRoutes` now returns it), never a copy. A path that is no address answers what the host answered before the route existed, `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`. It reaches the protocol as a service and imports nothing from metadata-protocol.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`**:
  - The qualified path is rewritten once at domain entry to the item read, before every gate (Q3's rule, applied here).
  - An anonymous caller is never rewritten, so the anonymous deny judges the path as REST's does (REST's public-audience exemption names no qualified shape).
  - A package-scoped refusal from `getMetaItem` is rethrown instead of falling through to the metadata service.
  - A refusal from reading the address itself answers `409` through `errorFromThrown`.
  - A caller the type-level read admission refuses (`metaTypeReadRefusal`, #21087) is never read as an address: the path stays three segments and the admission answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, as `RestServer`'s guarded registrar does before any `/meta` handler. So a refused caller never learns that a name exists or who holds it, and the two-qualifier `400` sits behind the same gate on both transports (contract delta review should-fix, fixed in 9297723e8).
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`**: a thrown package-scoped refusal answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the resolver's sentence and `candidates`, the shape `/actions` uses. The assignment-rule lookup refuses two declaring packages instead of taking the first.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`**: `installPackage` refuses a namespace that `validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral` (spec/kernel, P) refuses, `NamespaceAddressLiteralError` (`NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, 422), before K's object-name check.
- **Ledgers**: `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name` in runtime `route-ledger.ts` and `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:ns/:name` in `rest-route-ledger.ts`, both `server-only` (the SDK reaches the same item by `meta.getItem(type, name, { packageId })`). `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` pins `NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS` to the literal segments the ledger serves in each door's namespace position, both directions. `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` learns the route.
- **`.changeset/31691-meta-qualified-address.md`**: `minor` for core, objectql, metadata-protocol, rest and runtime; both declaration lines, the BREAKING list, the 405 note, FROM → TO fixes, the ADR-0087 marker.
- **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`**: the ledger learns the two new tests' engine doubles (`--write`). **`route-ledger.ts`**: the census sentence (`--fix`).

Forced test edits: `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` (its protocol double learns `resolveMetaItemAddress`, the driver fills `:ns`, and a module-top import), `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` (the new route), the canonical-fold roster (two verbs and a module-top import), and one existing dogfood assertion: `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces` pins the retired compound save as 405 `Allow: GET, HEAD` instead of 404 (see Verification).

## Step 0 (measured on `main` 80c4c9a28, report `/mnt/project-files/server-seat1/31691-step0.md`)

Door map, size estimate (≈4,200 lines, so three parts), ledgers and overlap (none) are in the step-0 report. The seat ruled three parts, each landing with its own contract review.

## ADR-0150's four readings

- **(a) the phase-1 one-holder tests stay green**: `bare-name-one-holder.ts` is untouched and its tests run in the objectql suite.
- **(b) bare-name behaviour unchanged for one-holder names**: CONTROLs on each door: a one-holder name read bare and by `?package=` of its holder; a type outside the nine (view) keeps the prefer-local read; a read naming no package is E8's, unchanged; a middle segment that is no installed namespace answers 404 as before; a sub-resource literal keeps its route; the activation door with one declaring package answers as before; namespaces `triggers` and `crm_hooks` install.
- **(c) no migration**: nothing stored changes shape. A refused namespace is the author's to rename.
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Carry-ins

1. **Pair reads keep their answer** (ui census note): `?package=PAIR` of a base-held item serves the base's item (also when another package registered the name first), the pair's declared override row is served at the pair, and the pair's added member is served at the pair. Pinned in `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`.
2. **The 409 face for Console**: a bare Console read of a name two packages hold (E8's nine types) already answered 409 on REST; this PR makes the runtime dispatcher answer it too. Console treats that 409 as absent. The ui lane files the reader card; this PR changes nothing under `ui/`.
3. **Activation door**: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with every candidate in `details.candidates`, pinned for sharing rule, queue and assignment rule. Base arms measured on f30369003: sharing rule and queue 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, assignment rule 200 (first match switched). The two-holder permission set or position is not reachable: `registerItem` refuses it with `SecurityCatalogNameConflictError`.

## Verification

Head dfb9174e6 (main merged at 13e935c67 and again at 9a7bdd7f1). Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`.

- **New tests**: install door 10 (`registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`); exact qualifier 14 (`package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`); runtime qualified read 17 (`meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, real dispatcher, protocol and registry, including anonymous parity); REST qualified route 14 (`meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, real route table, including the route order and the anonymous classification). Both of the last two carry the shared-namespace pair: two `sys` owners holding `page/home` answer 409 naming both; one holder is served; with two `sys` holders of a datasource name, a caller refused the type answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming neither, and an admitted caller (CONTROL) the 409; activation 9 (`catalog-activation-package-scoped.test.ts`); the grammar ↔ ledger pin.
- **Base arms**: the qualified path answered 404 on both transports (the dispatcher's `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, the REST host's unmatched `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`), and still does where the middle segment is no address; `?package=gamma` served alpha's page; activation as above.
- **Suites** (each `command-exit 0`, on the head): core 149 files / 3345 passed; objectql 584 / 11985 passed; metadata-protocol 331 (+5 skipped) / 22641 passed (29 skipped); rest 404 / 7956 passed (355 skipped); runtime 574 / 10570 passed (19 skipped). Rerun on dfb9174e6 (after the main merge and R1): core 149 / 3350; objectql 584 / 11988; metadata-protocol 331 (+5 skipped) / 22641 (29 skipped); rest 404 / 7958 (355 skipped); runtime 575 / 10592 (19 skipped); all exit 0. `tsc --noEmit` clean for core, objectql, metadata-protocol, rest and runtime on that head. **The whole dogfood package** before the gate-fix round: 441 (+3 skipped) / 3668 passed (42 skipped) with 1 red, `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces` (see below); that file and `route-ledger-live-mount-parity` rerun on the head: 96 passed. `packages/qa/http-conformance`: 20 / 275 passed. The runtime suite's `resolve-execution-context.agent-account` red seen once was a stale `plugin-security` dist (built before #31867's source); rebuilt, 7 passed.
- **The dogfood red, and the one forced dogfood edit**: `PUT /meta/object/views/<name>` (the retired compound save) answered 404 and now answers `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `Allow: GET, HEAD`. The adapter's unmatched sink answers 405 when the path matches a route under another verb, and `/meta/:type/:x/:y` now has the qualified GET. No PUT is routed and no auth floor speaks, for anonymous and member alike; the pin now asserts that (405, `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `allowed: [GET, HEAD]`) and the changeset names it.
- **Typecheck and lint**: `tsc --noEmit` passes for core, objectql, metadata-protocol, rest, runtime on the head, and the dogfood package on the first commit. `eslint --no-inline-config` passes on every changed file.
- **Gates**: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 93 families on the head (40a88d882, 9297723e8, and again on dfb9174e6); all 93 ran, exit 0 each time. `--ran`: 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first round (86 families, before `scripts/` was touched) surfaced 10 findings, all fixed in the second commit: `check:error-code-provenance` and `check:route-envelope` (the REST route now answers through `sendError`, its no-address 404 the host's own `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`), `check:undeclared-dep-imports` (rest no longer imports metadata-protocol: the sub-resource rule moved into `resolveMetaItemAddress`), `check:facade-delegation-only` (the protocol members forward in one call; the type folds in the module), `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger `--write`), `check:objectql-double-limit` and `check:where-matcher` (the new doubles hold `limit` and refuse operators), `check:test-source-alias` (module-top imports), `check:doc-authoring` (tracker ids out of the ledger notes) and `check:route-ledger-census` (`--fix`). `check:type-check-debt`: green.

<details><summary>Ablations (each file restored, tree checked unchanged)</summary>

Run on the first commit (6b3f20637); the second commit moves no guarded line except the sub-resource check, which A9 still covers.

1. `admitExactQualifier` off (returns `undefined`) → **5 of 13 red** in `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: every narrowing case.
2. `exactQualifierItem` off → **1 of 14 red**: the pair read where another package registered the name first serves beta's dashboard.
3. `admitEnvironmentQualifier` off → **1 of 13 red** in the runtime test: `_env` for a name only packages hold.
4. Runtime rethrow off (`isPackageScopedRefusal(e) && false`) → **3 of 13 red**: the bare two-holder read falls through to the service read.
5. Runtime anonymous rewrite (drop `!anonymous`) → **2 of 13 red**: the `?package=` case answers 400 before the deny, and `/book/alpha/guide` takes the public-audience exemption.
6. Install literal gate off → **7 of 10 red**: the six literals and the refusal shape; both CONTROLs stay green.
7. Activation `packageScopedRefusalOf` → `undefined` → **3 of 9 red**: sharing rule and queue back to 503, assignment rule back to the first match.
8. A fake ledger row `GET /meta/:type/history` → **1 red** in `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: the grammar pin.
9. REST route not registered → **6 of 10 red** in `meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`.
10. REST `_env` admit off → **1 of 10 red**.
11. (On 40a88d882) the `ambiguous-in-namespace` refusal off (take the first holder) → **1 red** in each of the REST (1 of 12) and runtime (1 of 15) tests: the two-holder `sys` read serves one of them; the one-holder control stays green.
12. (On 9297723e8) the runtime's new admission condition off → **1 of 17 red**: the refused caller answers the 409 naming both holders. The REST registrar's type gate off → **1 of 14 red**, the same case. Each CONTROL stays green.
13. (On 51c58a525 / dfb9174e6) the boot exemption off (`alreadyHeld = false`) → **2 of 12 red** in `registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` (the boot itself refused) and **1 of 18** in the runtime test (the `?package=` read of a `hooks` package); the reload arm off → **1 of 12**; the namespace match widened back to any registered id → **1 of 13** (the upgrade moving onto `hooks` installs).

</details>

## Open questions (seat's call)

1. **Q1 rule for the ADR amendment card.** The runtime's reading of D5's "a literal first": when the last segment of `/meta/:type/:x/:y` is a served sub-resource literal (`audit`, `diff`, `history`, `layers`, `publish`, `published`, `references`, `rollback`, `tree`), the sub-resource route wins, so `/meta/app/crm/history` is the history of app `crm`; an item named `history` in namespace `crm` is reached by `?package=`. Both readings are pinned. No spec constant spells this list; the ADR-0150 amendment card should state it in D5.
2. **`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`** (step 0 said `none` for the read path). The install refusal refuses a namespace value, which the AGENTS definition counts as narrowed, so the changeset is `minor`.
3. **405 on the qualified shape.** Non-GET verbs on `/meta/:type/:x/:y` now answer `405 Allow: GET, HEAD` (adapter behaviour for any path a route matches under another verb). Recommendation: keep; it is truthful, and the alternative is registering 404 stubs for each verb.
- **Names** (seat's call): `NamespaceAddressLiteralError`, refusal reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, `admitExactQualifier`, `exactQualifierItem`, `resolveMetaItemAddress`, `admitEnvironmentQualifier`, `META_ITEM_SUBRESOURCE_SEGMENTS`, `MetaItemAddress`, `registerMetaQualifiedItemRoute`, `MetaItemReadHandler`. No new error code.
- **Part (b) carry-in** (G2 review, 6743156352 / 6743815854): the qualified `/actions` arm's object-less fallback is settled in (b), not here.
